description: Publish a web page as the connected user. A siteId replaces an existing page at the same address. preserveFiles retains omitted assets and requires the baseDeploymentId of that version; stale edits are refused. Visibility is private (invitation-only, default) or public. Requires an authenticated AttachPage connection.

baseDeploymentId.description: Expected current version. A changed page is refused rather than overwritten.

files.description: Files of the page. The complete resulting page includes index.html at the top level.

content.description: File contents: text, or base64 when encoding is base64.

encoding.description: utf8 (default) for text files, base64 for images and other binary files.

path.description: Path inside the page, e.g. index.html or assets/logo.png.

preserveFiles.description: Retain files not included in this edit. Requires siteId and baseDeploymentId.

siteId.description: Replace this existing page at the same address.

siteName.description: Name shown to the user and recipients, e.g. "Q3 report".

slug.description: Optional address label, 3-40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Random when omitted.

visibility.description: private (invitation-only, default) or public (anyone with the link).

name: publish_page

siteId.description: Page id; pass it to replace the page later.

title: Publish page
